title: TinyLaunch Directories — paid SaaS directory submission for DR lift
summary: TinyLaunch sells done-for-you manual submissions to a vetted list of launch directories, promising Domain Rating lifts with tiered guarantees on a 110-directory package and case studies such as Flashcard Buddy 7→30 DR.
question_it_answers: What paid service submits a product to curated launch directories to raise Domain Rating?

claims.text: The 110-directory package guarantees minimum DR bands such as 15–20 when starting from DR 0–10.
claims.subject: serp-ai-visibility

claims.text: Turnaround is roughly ten days from purchase through submissions and a full report.
claims.evidence: Submissions + full report within ~1 week (total ~10 days)
